We first identify how operationalizations of faithfulness differ. We introduce a faithfulness functional that locates their disagreements in what an explanation claims about the model, which comparisons bear on that claim, and how agreement across those comparisons should be aggregated, and we reconstruct existing evaluation criteria within it. We argue these reconstructions support understanding faithfulness as a common though incompletely specified relation between the model and explanation, so the differences reflect choices left open by the general requirement. Justifying an operationalization then comes down to justifying these choices, which, on our view, draws on explanatory, institutional, and normative considerations. We support this argument with a case study of adverse action notices, reconstructing the evaluation implicit in an industry-proposed procedure and identifying which of its choices the setting justifies and which remain open. Our work gives auditors and practitioners a way to navigate disagreeing evaluations of faithfulness. It also explains why the literature should expect multiple operationalizations, while showing how concrete settings can narrow the choice among them. More broadly, our analysis shows how a shared requirement of faithfulness can support contextually justified evaluations despite disagreement among existing metrics.
items.title_ko: 설명 충실도 평가 기준 간의 불일치 탐색
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 AI 모델 설명의 '충실도(faithfulness)'를 평가하는 기존 기준들 간의 불일치를 조사하고, 설명의 충실도를 평가하기 위한 실용적인 방향을 제시합니다. 이는 설명의 작동 방식과 평가 기준의 차이를 식별합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델 설명의 신뢰성 및 해석 가능성을 평가하는 데 있어 발생하는 과제를 해결하고, 개발자와 감사자가 일관된 평가를 수행할 수 있도록 돕는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Thermally Conditioned Time-Series Forecasting of Grain Growth in Polycrystalline Materials
items.body: Grain growth during heat treatment strongly affects the microstructure of polycrystalline materials and, consequently, their mechanical properties. Although numerical methods such as front-tracking or front-capturing simulations can accurately describe grain growth, their high computational cost limits their use for long or non-isothermal thermal cycles. In previous work, grain growth was successfully predicted under isothermal conditions by treating grain size distributions as time series and forecasting their evolution using recurrent neural networks, allowing complete grain growth trajectories to be generated in seconds rather than through costly PDE-based simulations. In the present work, this forecasting framework is reformulated to handle non-isothermal conditions by explicitly incorporating thermal information into the model architecture. Grain size distributions are encoded using a convolutional neural network, thermal descriptors are embedded through a dedicated multilayer perceptron, and temporal evolution is predicted using a recurrent network. Instantaneous temperature and thermal rate are provided at each time step, allowing the model to adapt its predictions to changing thermal conditions. The framework is trained and evaluated on datasets generated from validated front-tracking simulations across a wide range of non-isothermal thermal paths. The results show that the thermally conditioned model accurately reproduces grain growth dynamics under complex thermal histories, achieving, in k-fold cross-validation over all simulations, mean relative errors of 2.99% (one-hour cycles) and 4.51% (four-hour cycles) with coefficients of determination exceeding 0.99, and mean relative errors between 1.91% and 14.66% on ten simulations following four unseen thermal histories of increasing complexity.
items.title_ko: 열 조건부 다결정 재료 결정립 성장 시계열 예측
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 열처리 중 다결정 재료의 결정립 성장을 시계열 예측으로 설명하는 방법을 다룹니다. 높은 계산 비용 때문에 장기간 또는 비등온 열 사이클에 사용이 제한적인 기존 수치 방법의 한계를 극복하고자 합니다.
items.why_ko: 재료 과학 분야에서 복잡한 물리적 현상을 예측하는 AI 모델 개발에 기여하며, 공정 최적화 및 신소재 개발에 활용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: ServerBench: How can your coding agents design specialized LLM serving systems?
items.body: Large language model (LLM) coding agents develop software through experimentation, offering an opportunity to design the serving systems supporting their own operation. Effective serving requires coordinating implementation and operating decisions under session dependencies, latency constraints, and correctness requirements. We introduce ServerBench, a benchmark for agentic design of complete, specialized LLM serving systems. Agents experiment against a common objective, dollars per dollar: latency-qualified token value per dollar of GPU cost. Stateful replay preserves session dependencies, and independent verification checks the submitted system. Across 11 coding-agent models and three deployments, Claude Sonnet 5.5 achieves 2.97 dollars per dollar on Gemma E4B, $4.87\times$ the vLLM reference; 22 of 33 runs yield verified systems, and 13 exceed the strongest baseline. Our analysis identifies three findings: high-value designs coordinate capacity improvements with load selection; agents interpret performance feedback through workload-relevant experiments; and reliable delivery requires verification of the execution paths introduced by optimization. Overall, ServerBench supports systematic study of how agents translate service objectives and feedback into effective, verified serving systems for given task specifications.
items.title_ko: ServerBench: 코딩 에이전트가 LLM 서빙 시스템을 설계하는 방법 평가
items.summary_ko: ServerBench는 LLM 코딩 에이전트가 완전하고 특화된 LLM 서빙 시스템을 설계하는 능력을 평가하는 벤치마크입니다. 에이전트는 세션 종속성, 지연 시간 제약, 정확성 요구 사항 하에서 구현 및 운영 결정을 조정해야 합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트가 스스로 AI 시스템 인프라를 설계하고 최적화하는 '재귀적 자기 개선' 능력을 평가하는 중요한 벤치마크로, AI 개발 및 운영 자동화에 기여합니다.

items.title: Same Layout, Different Count: What Number Words Do Past Ten in Text-to-Image Models
items.body: Ask SD3.5-Medium for twelve of an object and then, from the same starting noise, for twenty-five. The picture keeps its layout, but the count changes about as much as it would under a new random seed, and in no consistent direction. We study what number words do once a request passes about ten objects, in five open text-to-image models. Holding the object and the starting noise fixed, we change one thing at a time, and people who never see the request count 3,088 of the images. Every model follows the number for small crowds, but only up to a point, its reach: SD3.5-M and FLUX.1-dev stop following it soon after ten, while FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image follow it loosely up to twenty-five. Beyond SD3.5-M's reach, the coarse part of the starting noise fixes the composition of the picture but not how many objects it holds: redrawing only the noise finer than an eighth of the image keeps the layout as well as a new number does, and already moves the count two-thirds as far. The number word still reaches the denoiser and acts in its first steps, but nothing we tried gives it a clear direction. Shown instead as a noised grid in the starting latent, the count is drawn: people find it in 59% of images, against 4% when it is only told. Past ten, an exact-match score barely separates a model that follows the number loosely from one that ignores it, and a relative-error score can even prefer a constant guess of sixteen. A same-noise test with a few requests per object tells them apart.
items.title_ko: 동일한 레이아웃, 다른 개수: 텍스트-이미지 모델의 숫자 단어 처리 방식
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 SD3.5-Medium을 포함한 5가지 오픈 텍스트-이미지 모델이 '약 10개 이상'의 객체 수를 요청받았을 때 어떻게 처리하는지 조사합니다. 모델은 레이아웃을 유지하지만, 실제 개수는 무작위 시드를 바꿨을 때와 비슷하게 변동하며 일관된 방향성을 보이지 않습니다.
items.why_ko: 텍스트-이미지 모델이 높은 개수의 객체를 정확하게 제어하는 데 어려움을 겪는다는 한계를 밝히며, 모델의 제어력 향상을 위한 연구 방향을 제시합니다.

items.title: Before You Continue: Evaluating Time-Sensitive Safety Awareness in Conversational Assistants
items.body: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly help users with everyday activities that involve time-dependent constraints. However, users may not mention these constraints in later requests, requiring assistants to recognize and adjust their advice accordingly. To evaluate such capability, we introduce TASC (Temporal Action Safety in Conversation), a benchmark that evaluates whether LLMs apply time-dependent constraints when responding to conversational requests. TASC consists of 3,418 inputs derived from 128 templates, along with a separate set of 33 scenarios designed to compare models' ability to calculate elapsed time with their ability to apply that information. Across 13 models, assistants account for time-dependent constraints in only 30.5% of cases where the proposed action violates a rule, while rarely warning users unnecessarily. More importantly, models fail to apply these constraints in 62.1% of cases despite correctly calculating the elapsed time. Explicitly providing the timing resolves only about half of these failures, revealing a gap between temporal reasoning and its application in conversational advice.
items.title_ko: 계속하기 전에: 대화형 어시스턴트의 시간 민감 안전 인식 평가
items.summary_ko: TASC(Temporal Action Safety in Conversation)는 LLM이 대화형 요청에 응답할 때 시간 종속적 제약 조건을 인식하고 적용하는지 평가하는 벤치마크입니다. 이는 일상 활동에서 시간 제약이 있는 사용자 요청을 어시스턴트가 적절히 처리하는 능력을 측정합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 비서가 시간 민감 정보를 효과적으로 처리하여 사용자에게 안전하고 적절한 조언을 제공할 수 있는지 평가하는 중요한 도구이며, 실제 시나리오에서 AI의 신뢰성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Context--Answer Metamodels: Forecasting LLM Activations Before the First Answer Token
items.body: Under stochastic decoding, a single context can elicit many different answers from a language model. Characterizing this variation typically requires many expensive autoregressive rollouts, each revealing only one realization. We ask whether the activations produced while reading the context can directly forecast the model's rollout activations. We train context--answer metamodels that map a context activation sequence to point or distribution forecasts of mean-pooled answer activations. We find that (i) the four metamodel families we study forecast mean-pooled answer activations with high fidelity, and the distribution metamodels also capture rollout variability; (ii) performance improves as the training set grows to 500,000 prompts, and the metamodels generalize zero-shot to out-of-domain datasets; (iii) their forecasts retain behavior-predictive signal; and (iv) context activations from Qwen2.5 predict mean-pooled answer activations from Qwen3.5 and Gemma 4, suggesting that activation forecasts can transfer across models. Together, these results suggest that context activation traces can support scalable forecasts of behaviors in LLM answers before the first answer token is generated.
items.title_ko: 컨텍스트-응답 메타모델: 첫 번째 응답 토큰 이전에 LLM 활성화 예측
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 문맥을 읽는 동안 생성되는 활성화가 언어 모델의 롤아웃 활성화를 직접 예측할 수 있는지 질문합니다. 컨텍스트 활성화 시퀀스를 평균 풀링된 응답 활성화의 점 또는 분포 예측으로 매핑하는 컨텍스트-응답 메타모델을 훈련합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 내부 작동 방식과 예측 메커니즘을 이해하는 데 도움이 되는 연구로, 모델의 동작을 더 빠르고 효율적으로 분석할 수 있는 가능성을 제시합니다.

items.title: LooM: Loop-Invariant Memory for Causal Encoder-Decoder Language Models
items.body: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by re-executing shared layers, but three limitations hinder their adoption: memory grows with the loop count, compute can only be adjusted in whole-block steps, and the loop count is hard to change after training. We propose LooM (Loop-invariant Memory), which addresses each in turn. In a causal encoder-decoder (CED), LooM loops only the decoder layers after the first, which read a global memory written once per token, and each of them publishes the key-value (KV) entry for a token only on its first visit, so the cache does not grow with the loop count. These layers loop independently, providing every budget from 3 to 21 layer executions per token, and one model trained on randomly sampled budgets covers all of them without a router. With enough loops, LooM outperforms a single-pass baseline trained on the same data on language modeling, zero-shot accuracy and long-context perplexity, while using the same cache size. Our analysis further shows that the training budget distribution decides what extra depth buys. These results suggest that a CED is a natural place to loop: memory is written once, and depth becomes a budget chosen at deployment.
items.title_ko: LooM: 인과적 인코더-디코더 언어 모델을 위한 루프 불변 메모리
items.summary_ko: LooM(Loop-invariant Memory)은 루프형 트랜스포머의 메모리 증가, 컴퓨팅 조정의 한계, 훈련 후 루프 카운트 변경 어려움 등의 문제를 해결합니다. 이는 인과적 인코더-디코더(CED)에서 첫 번째 디코더 레이어 이후에만 루프를 실행하여 각 토큰당 한 번만 작성되는 전역 메모리를 읽고 게시합니다.
items.why_ko: 루프형 트랜스포머의 효율성과 유연성을 향상시키는 새로운 아키텍처를 제시하여, 더 깊고 강력한 언어 모델의 개발을 가능하게 합니다.

items.title: Alignment Myopia in Generative AI
items.body: Current generative AI alignment relies on a myopic paradigm that prioritizes immediate conversational satisfaction. By relying on short-horizon feedback, this approach ignores the profound, longitudinal externalities of persistent human-AI interaction, which can lead to adverse outcomes such as cognitive atrophy, social erosion, and diminished human agency. To address this, we propose a paradigm shift toward long-horizon alignment that accounts for how AI reshapes human experience over time. To this end, we map the tensions between near-term utility and long-term costs of AI use across four facets of human well-being to reveal outcomes that current reward models fail to capture. Ultimately, we advocate for moving beyond simple preference optimization toward alignment strategies that actively foster long-term human well-being by navigating these complex temporal scales.
items.title_ko: 생성형 AI의 정렬 근시안성
items.summary_ko: 현재 생성형 AI 정렬은 즉각적인 대화 만족도에만 초점을 맞추는 근시안적 패러다임에 의존하고 있습니다. 이 접근 방식은 장기적인 인간-AI 상호작용의 심오한 외부 효과(인지 위축, 사회적 침식, 인간 주체성 감소 등)를 무시합니다.
items.why_ko: 단기적인 성능 지표를 넘어 장기적인 관점에서 AI의 사회적 영향과 인간 경험 변화를 고려해야 할 필요성을 제기하며, AI 개발의 윤리적 방향성에 대한 중요한 질문을 던집니다.

items.title: Enabling AWS Cloud FPGA Development Using High-Level Vitis HLS
items.body: We present a toolchain for development of ML models on AWS EC2 F2 cloud FPGA infrastructure from high-level language, implementing a complete Vitis HLS to HDK bridge to AFI workflow that has been absent from the academic literature despite eight years of AWS FPGA availability. We introduce a four-level methodology (FP32 PyTorch, bit-accurate quantized Python, HLS C-simulation, physical FPGA) to aid in localizing errors, including FPGA-specific circuit errors. Together these tools allow coding agents to effectively implement FPGA designs from user directions, testing and debugging as needed. We document the deployment workflow, timing closure strategies, and practical HLS engineering decisions that proved crucial. We validate using TinyBERT fine-tuned for address Named Entity Recognition, implementing the embedding layer and the first of four encoder layers on the FPGA hardware. Our implementation streams weights from host DRAM, yielding poor performance compared to CPU/GPU implementations; we discuss forward paths.
items.title_ko: 고수준 Vitis HLS를 이용한 AWS 클라우드 FPGA 개발 가능화
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 고수준 언어에서 AWS EC2 F2 클라우드 FPGA 인프라에서 ML 모델을 개발하기 위한 도구 체인을 제시합니다. Vitis HLS에서 HDK 브리지로, AFI 워크플로를 위한 완벽한 솔루션을 구현하며, 오류 지역화를 돕는 4단계 방법론을 소개합니다.
items.why_ko: AWS FPGA를 활용한 머신러닝 모델 개발을 위한 실용적인 가이드라인과 도구 체인을 제공하여, 개발자들이 고성능 컴퓨팅 환경을 효율적으로 활용할 수 있도록 돕습니다.

items.title: Systolic Linear Attention: Co-Designing Tile-Grouped Gated Delta Attention for TPUs
items.body: Gated-delta linear attention layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), and GDN-2 are tuned for GPUs, where small tensor-core tiles and fast vector registers make per-channel decay rescaling and sequential in-block solves cheap. On Google TPUs, which concentrate compute in wide $256 \times 256$ systolic matrix units backed by a slower vector unit, porting these layers directly leaves half of each matrix tile empty and bottlenecks on vector operations. We present \textbf{Systolic Linear Attention (SLA)}, which reshapes gated delta attention around the matrix unit by widening keys to $256$ with grouped value heads, grouping decay gates into four $64$-channel tiles, and computing the chunk solve entirely with block matrix products in a single fused kernel. On TPU v7x, a full \texttt{SLA-R4} layer runs $1.6\times$--$2.5\times$ faster than the open-source Tokamax KDA kernel ($1.4\times$--$2.4\times$ with exact chunk inversion), driven primarily by head sharing and kernel fusion. Across a $2{,}048$-chip TPU v7x pre-training study of sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models from $6.5\text{B}$ to $63.1\text{B}$ parameters, SLA trains $11\%$--$24\%$ faster than KDA at similar perplexity, and reaches slightly lower perplexity than KDA in smaller matched-seed runs.
items.title_ko: Systolic Linear Attention: TPU를 위한 타일 그룹 게이트 델타 어텐션 공동 설계
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 Google TPU를 위한 Systolic Linear Attention을 제안하며, GPU에 최적화된 Gated-delta 선형 어텐션 레이어(GDN, KDA, GDN-2)를 TPU 아키텍처에 맞게 공동 설계합니다. 넓은 256x256 시스톨릭 행렬 단위를 효율적으로 활용하여 성능 병목 현상을 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: 특정 하드웨어 아키텍처(TPU)에 최적화된 어텐션 메커니즘을 설계함으로써, AI 모델의 하드웨어 가속 성능을 극대화하는 방법을 제시합니다.

items.title: Rules, Traces and Routing Statistics: Training and Calibration Data for Open Models on ARC-AGI-2
items.body: We study which training and calibration data help three open models solve ARC-AGI-2 tasks when the solver runs offline on four L4 GPUs for at most 12 hours. We compare data offline on public tasks and report 189 runs on the 120 hidden semi-private tasks. For the NVARC Qwen3-4B grid model, we built a corpus of 12,000 executable rules in a typed language and 95,993 tasks; a rule is admitted only if its behaviour on a fixed probe set differs from that of every admitted rule, and a task only if its pairs refute a shortlist of nearest competing rules and defeat 12 shortcut solvers. Continued fine-tuning on 1,920 real task records with revised four-GPU scheduling raised the semi-private score from 28.96 (mean of the released model) to 33.06 (mean of five runs, best 34.86); no checkpoint trained with synthetic tasks, even all 95,993 of them, improved on the real-task model. For the Qwen3.8-27B reasoning model, we fine-tuned on 1,036 of its own reasoning traces with correct final answers and compared sets that add traces of other models and synthetic tasks. With an inference procedure built around the model (a thinking cap enforced in the serving engine, a Python program checked on the demonstrations after each answer, a long first attempt per input), the score rose from 26.81 to 44.03, the level the ARC Prize Foundation measured for the base model without a time limit (42.36); most of the gain came from the inference procedure. For the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next mixture-of-experts model (125B parameters, 6B active), GPU memory limited concurrency. Pruning from 512 to 384 experts per layer by router-weighted activation saliency grew the key-value cache from 0.55M to 1.39M tokens; a 296-expert list adapted with ARC routing statistics, keeping experts for program tokens, plus an FP8 indexer cache, reached 1.96M. With a tool that checks programs, the model scored 56.67, our best result.
items.title_ko: ARC-AGI-2의 오픈 모델 훈련 및 교정 데이터: 규칙, 추적 및 라우팅 통계
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 ARC-AGI-2 태스크를 해결하는 데 어떤 훈련 및 교정 데이터가 세 가지 오픈 모델에 도움이 되는지 조사합니다. 12,000개의 실행 가능한 규칙과 95,993개의 태스크로 구성된 코퍼스를 구축하여 모델 성능을 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: ARC-AGI와 같은 복잡한 추론 태스크에서 AI 모델의 성능을 향상시키는 데 필요한 데이터 구성 및 활용에 대한 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: GFlowQEC: Generative Flow Networks that Learn to Sample Quantum LDPC Codes
items.body: Choosing a quantum error-correcting code for a real device means scoring candidates with circuit-level simulations so slow that only a few hundred can be run. So every evaluation counts, and a search is judged by how many good codes it finds per paid evaluation. Quantum LDPC codes built from a few group elements protect many logical qubits, but good ones are rare in a huge space. We introduce GFlowQEC, to our knowledge the first generative flow network (GFlowNet) for quantum code design. It builds a code one group element at a time and learns to propose codes in proportion to a power of their score. We train it once on scores from earlier searches, freeze it, and let it propose lifted-product codes with 180 physical qubits, scored by their distances. Ranking ten of its draws per paid call, it finds more than twice as many new top-scoring codes (inequivalent to any it was trained on) as tuned parallel tempering, even when tempering starts from GFlowQEC's training codes. It finds more than three and a half times as many as a supervised screen ranking ten random candidates per call. When both rank a hundred, the screen beats GFlowQEC, and does best ranking GFlowQEC's draws. Soft Q-learning, which shares the GFlowNet's optimal policy, does as well at one noise bias and better at the other, so the gain does not depend on the GFlowNet's training loss. Trained proposers can make a budget of expensive evaluations go further when good codes are rare.
items.title_ko: GFlowQEC: 양자 LDPC 코드 샘플링을 학습하는 생성 흐름 네트워크
items.summary_ko: GFlowQEC는 양자 코드 설계를 위한 최초의 생성 흐름 네트워크(GFlowNet)로, 실제 장치에 적합한 양자 오류 정정 코드(Quantum LDPC codes)를 효율적으로 샘플링합니다. 이는 수백 개만 평가 가능한 시뮬레이션 환경에서 좋은 코드를 찾는 데 중점을 둡니다.
items.why_ko: 양자 오류 정정 코드 설계의 효율성을 크게 향상시킬 수 있는 새로운 AI 기반 접근 방식을 제시하며, 양자 컴퓨팅의 실제 적용을 가속화하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: SAUCE: Summary Analysis Using Conversation Entailment
items.body: With the growing need for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) and their applications to speech, challenges persist in summarizing and evaluating conversations that lack a clear end goal. We introduce SAUCE -- a reference-free, fact-based evaluation pipeline for cross-lingual conversational speech summarization. It measures the accuracy and the fact coverage of a summary through the entailment between conversation and text. We compare SAUCE against several popular summarization metrics and demonstrate the effectiveness of capturing information loss due to transcription and translation error and identifying broken summaries. Crucially, unlike black-box LLM evaluators or dense embedding metrics, SAUCE is inherently explainable: it maps summary scores to discrete, verifiable facts, allowing users to pinpoint exact hallucinations or omissions. We illustrate how this interpretability helps developers systematically profile LLM behaviors and gives end-users an actionable tool to verify summary accuracy in noisy, real-world conditions. Preliminary investigations show SAUCE strongly align with human judgment.
items.title_ko: SAUCE: 대화 함의를 이용한 요약 분석
items.summary_ko: SAUCE는 명확한 목표가 없는 대화 요약을 평가하기 위한 참조 없는 사실 기반 평가 파이프라인입니다. 대화와 텍스트 간의 함의를 통해 요약의 정확성과 사실 포함도를 측정합니다.
items.why_ko: 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)의 대화형 음성 요약 성능을 효과적으로 평가하는 새로운 방법을 제시하여, LLM 기반 요약 시스템의 개발 및 개선에 기여합니다.

items.title: Evolutionary Design of Interpretable Spatial Descriptors for Structure-Property Relationship Discovery
items.body: Structure property prediction is a classical task in machine learning, ranging from molecular activity and materials properties to local functional responses measured in microscopy. For image-based regression, two choices define the information available to the predictor: the size of the image neighborhood and the spatial resolution retained within it. A small neighborhood can omit relevant surrounding structure, whereas a large, finely sampled neighborhood can introduce redundant or irrelevant information. Here, we develop a framework for constructing spatial descriptors for prediction of local spectra and hysteresis loops. We benchmark regression models, use SHAP maps to examine their spatial attribution, and explore the effect of the patch size and compression to establish the relationship between predictive accuracy and descriptor dimensionality. We then use a genetic algorithm to optimize spatial partitions and the assignment of mean, minimum, and maximum pooling operations. Each retained region contributes an explicit measurement of the image, allowing the search to balance prediction error against the number of descriptor values. Cartesian and polar constructions provide complementary ways to organize this information. The resulting descriptors make it possible to examine where spatial detail is needed, where regional summaries are sufficient, and how these choices depend on the predictor and the measured response. The same approach can be used for molecules and solids once the genetic algorithm rules for these are established.
items.title_ko: 해석 가능한 구조-속성 관계 발견을 위한 공간 디스크립터의 진화적 설계
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 이미지 기반 회귀에서 구조-속성 관계를 발견하기 위해 해석 가능한 공간 디스크립터의 진화적 설계를 제안합니다. 이미지 이웃의 크기와 공간 해상도 간의 정보 트레이드오프 문제를 해결하여 예측 모델에 가장 관련성 높은 정보를 제공하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
items.why_ko: 재료 과학 및 이미지 분석 분야에서 모델 해석 가능성을 높이고, 특정 속성을 예측하는 데 가장 중요한 시각적 특징을 식별하는 데 도움을 줍니다.

items.title: LLMs Don't Know What They Know: Benchmarking Temporal Self-Knowledge for Financial Backtesting
items.body: Financial backtests of large language models (LLMs) are meaningful only if the model did not already know the outcomes it is asked to predict. Practitioners guard against this by trusting a vendor's stated knowledge cutoff, by asking the model what it knows, or by instructing it to answer as of a past date. To verify whether any of these safeguards can be trusted, we introduce FinDendro, a benchmark of 2,226 dated U.S. facts from 1999 to 2026, covering monthly macroeconomic series, month-end stock prices and Federal Reserve decisions. Each fact yields four prompts: a value question, Recall and Predict questions that pair each candidate value with a claim of knowing or guessing without a declared date, and a Predict question with a historical declared date. Controls for persistence and dominant outcomes keep chance accuracy near 0.27. Results show that for most frontier models, self-reports understate knowledge. GPT-5 answers 76% of controlled facts correctly but claims to know 38%, and answers 61% of the facts it says it does not know. Knowledge claims can persist beyond the measured knowledge boundary, by up to seven quarters, and a declared date removes most of the claims of prior knowledge while leaving accuracy unchanged. Backtests inside a model's training window therefore cannot be certified leak-free by self-report, instruction or stated cutoff. These findings motivate behavioral measurement of temporal knowledge boundaries, and FinDendro provides a benchmark and procedure for selecting backtest periods based on demonstrated factual knowledge.
items.title_ko: LLM은 자신이 무엇을 아는지 모른다: 금융 백테스팅을 위한 시간적 자기 지식 벤치마킹
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 LLM의 금융 백테스팅이 모델이 이미 결과를 알고 있지 않았다는 전제 하에 유의미한지 검증합니다. FinDendro 벤치마크를 통해 1999년부터 2026년까지의 2,226개 미국 금융 사실에 대한 모델의 시간적 자기 지식(temporal self-knowledge)을 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM을 금융 백테스팅에 활용할 때 중요한 데이터 유출(data leakage) 문제를 다루며, 모델의 지식 범위와 시점별 답변 신뢰성을 검증하는 데 필수적인 방법을 제시합니다.

items.title: Measuring Risk, Not Harm: Detecting Psychological Harm Risk Factors in LLM Conversations
items.body: Psychological harms from interactions with large language models cannot be monitored directly because they may emerge over repeated interactions and depend strongly on subjective individual user context. We propose measuring risk, not harm: detecting observable AI behaviors that constitute risk factors for psychological harm at the AI response level and aggregating these signals to support longitudinal monitoring. We operationalize eight such behaviors and construct a synthetic multi-label corpus of 47,062 AI responses and 373,873 response-factor labels, with targeted human annotations for validation and evaluation. We then compare trained embedding-based classifiers, direct LLM judging, and a classifier--judge cascade. All detectors are model-agnostic and operate only on LLM outputs, requiring no access to internal model states. We apply these detectors to several out-of-distribution human-AI conversation data sets from prior research. On held-out human-labeled data, the best cascade achieves macro precision of 0.86, recall of 0.76, and F1 of 0.79. On WildChat, it reduces LLM-judge calls by 97.1\% relative to direct judging. On DelusionEval, risk-factor detections cluster within conversations. Together, our results show that response-level behavioral risk-factor detection can provide a scalable measurement layer for longitudinal psychological-safety monitoring without conflating observable AI behavior with latent user harm.
items.title_ko: 피해 측정이 아닌 위험 측정: LLM 대화에서 심리적 피해 위험 요소 감지
items.summary_ko: LLM 상호작용으로 인한 심리적 피해는 직접 모니터링하기 어렵기 때문에, 이 연구는 피해가 발생할 위험 요소가 되는 AI 행동을 감지하는 방법을 제안합니다. 8가지 위험 요소를 정의하고 합성 멀티 라벨 코퍼스를 구축하여 장기적인 모니터링을 지원합니다.
items.why_ko: AI와의 상호작용에서 발생할 수 있는 잠재적인 심리적 피해를 사전에 감지하고 완화하기 위한 중요한 접근 방식을 제시하며, AI의 윤리적 사용을 위한 실제적인 지침을 제공합니다.

items.title: Task-Efficient Agent Evaluation Using Cached Traces
items.body: Efficient benchmarking estimates a system's full benchmark performance from a small number of task executions. Standard approaches rely solely on the binary correctness of executions from a collection of already-evaluated reference systems. An agentic system, however, produces a rich trace for each execution that can reveal substantially more about its capabilities. Leveraging this information requires useful trace representations. We propose representing a trace by extracting a structured summary of it with an LLM and embedding the summary with a standard text encoder. These representations preserve correctness- and task-related signal while minimizing the presence of system identity-, model family- and harness-related signals that dominate raw trace embeddings. Given this representation for each task execution from all reference systems, we construct low-dimensional representations of the systems and predict a new system's score from its position among the reference systems. On SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0, augmenting an item-response model with this geometry-based prediction reduces mean absolute error from 0.13 to 0.08 (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-4}$) and from 0.14 to 0.12 (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-3}$), respectively, when provided a single random executed task. Further, given access to the full set of reference systems, our approach dominates baselines for any given number of executed tasks on both benchmarks.
items.title_ko: 캐시된 트레이스를 이용한 태스크 효율적인 에이전트 평가
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 캐시된 실행 트레이스를 활용하여 에이전트 시스템의 전체 벤치마크 성능을 적은 수의 태스크 실행으로 추정하는 효율적인 벤치마킹 방법을 제안합니다. 풍부한 트레이스 정보를 구조화된 요약으로 추출하여 에이전트의 능력을 파악합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트의 평가 비용과 시간을 크게 절감할 수 있는 효율적인 방법을 제시하여, 에이전트 개발 및 개선 주기를 단축하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: ConDR: Conservative Reachability through Neural Hamilton-Jacobi Subsolutions
items.body: Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) Reachability identifies the unsafe states of a dynamical system from which it can be forced into failure under worst-case disturbance. However, classical grid-based solvers scale exponentially with state dimension. DeepReach improves scalability by replacing the grid with a neural value function trained on the HJ-Isaacs (HJI) variational inequality (VI), but penalizes both sides of the residual equally. This allows the learned value to lie above the true one and unsafe states to be misclassified as safe. We propose Conservative DeepReach (ConDR) which aims to learn a subsolution of the HJI VI such that the learned unsafe set contains the true one. ConDR enforces the obstacle branch and terminal condition by construction, pushes the HJI residual to a safety margin $ε$ below zero with a one-sided loss, and prevents the degenerate solution of classifying everything as unsafe. We prove that the exact solution of the margin-shifted VI that ConDR trains toward is a subsolution of the original VI so its unsafe set contains the true one and its value lies within $ετ$ of the true value function. We compare against DeepReach and MADR in the established systems of Air3D, Air6D, a 9D multi-vehicle system, and a 13D quadrotor. ConDR reports the lowest rate of unsafe state misclassified and the lowest closed-loop collision rates with at most a small increase in intervention. On Air3D and Air6D, ConDR tolerates model mismatch that scales with $ε$. At matched false-negative rates, ConDR's unsafe sets are smaller than the baselines showing the safety is not obtained by trivial over-approximation.
items.title_ko: ConDR: 신경망 해밀턴-야코비 하위 솔루션을 통한 보수적 도달 가능성
items.summary_ko: ConDR은 신경망 해밀턴-야코비(HJ) 하위 솔루션을 사용하여 동적 시스템의 안전하지 않은 상태를 식별하는 보수적 도달 가능성 방법을 제안합니다. 기존 DeepReach의 문제점을 개선하여 학습된 값이 실제 값보다 낮게 유지되도록 합니다.
items.why_ko: 복잡한 동적 시스템의 안전 영역을 보수적으로 예측하는 데 중요한 기술로, 자율 시스템의 안전성 및 신뢰성을 높이는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Message-passing graph persistence
items.body: Message-passing graph neural networks (GNNs) are limited in expressive power by the one-dimensional Weisfeiler-Leman test. Persistent homology (PH) provides topological descriptors that can complement GNN representations, but existing approaches typically compute persistence separately from the representation learning process. In this paper, we introduce Message-Passing Graph Persistence (MGP), a family of topological descriptors that incorporates message passing into graph filtrations. At each filtration step, node embeddings are updated using the current subgraph and associated with persistence events. These embeddings also determine the representatives of connected components during persistence computation. We prove that MGP is invariant under graph isomorphism and that it is strictly more expressive than the PH-based descriptors it extends. We evaluate MGP on an expressivity benchmark and on several graph classification and regression datasets. Experiments show that MGP outperforms other PH-based descriptors on most of these datasets.
items.title_ko: 메시지 전달 그래프 지속성
items.summary_ko: 메시지 전달 그래프 지속성(MGP)은 메시지 전달 그래프 신경망(GNN)의 표현 능력을 보완하기 위해 그래프 필트레이션에 메시지 전달을 통합하는 위상 디스크립터 패밀리를 소개합니다. 이는 GNN의 한계를 극복하고 그래프 표현을 풍부하게 합니다.
items.why_ko: 그래프 신경망(GNN)의 표현 능력과 표현력을 향상시키는 새로운 접근 방식을 제시하며, 복잡한 그래프 데이터 분석 및 이해에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Transforming Integer Grids to Spatial Intuition: Perception, Not Planning, Governs ARC-AGI-3
items.body: Sample-efficient fluid intelligence requires agents that rapidly form working models of unfamiliar interactive environments. ARC-AGI-3 tests this across uninstructed visual games scored by Relative Human Action Efficiency, which penalizes exploratory waste quadratically. When frontier models read raw integer grids, serialization destroys spatial topology, and they spend hundreds of actions rediscovering basic boundaries and symmetries. We introduce SARBLOH, an open-weight agent built on the premise that spatial perception, not planning capacity, governs interactive reasoning on ARC-AGI-3. A zero-parameter O(HW) perception engine turns each frame, in 35 ms, into an object inventory with bipartite temporal tracking, a geometric briefing that separates proven invariants from affordance hypotheses, and an annotated canvas. Paired with a code-as-action runtime, the agent writes algorithmic hypotheses instead of low-level moves. Across eight presentations, grounded perception raises the rubric score from 3/28 to 25/28 points while cutting token use by 89.4%. On 23 held-out games, geometric invariants generalize with 100% accuracy, while single-frame affordance guesses fall to 6-50%, so active verification probes remain necessary. On the public set, Run A (briefing off) solved 143 of 183 levels in 8.2 hours at 59.4% single-pass efficiency; Run B (briefing on) reached 63.5%. Within the nine-hour budget on one Kaggle RTX PRO 6000 GPU, SARBLOH scored 16.53 on the hidden Kaggle evaluation, 13.7x the first Milestone winner.
items.title_ko: 정수 그리드를 공간 직관으로 변환: ARC-AGI-3을 지배하는 것은 계획이 아닌 인지
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 ARC-AGI-3 태스크에서 에이전트가 새로운 상호작용 환경의 작동 모델을 빠르게 형성하는 능력을 시험합니다. SARBLOH라는 오픈 가중치 에이전트를 소개하며, 원시 정수 그리드를 읽는 모델들이 공간 위상 정보를 파괴하여 기본적인 경계와 대칭성을 재발견하는 데 많은 시간을 낭비한다는 점을 지적합니다.
items.why_ko: 샘플 효율적인 추론 능력을 갖춘 AI 에이전트를 개발하기 위한 새로운 통찰을 제공하며, 복잡한 시각적 추론 태스크에서 AI 모델의 인지적 한계를 해결하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Ranking Agreement Does Not Reveal Paragraph-Edit Agreement in Two Released Paper Acceptance Predictors
items.body: A fast acceptance classifier could select revisions for a slower evaluator. We ask whether agreement on existing papers supports that use. We compare a classifier of word and document features with two released text-only acceptance predictors fine-tuned from the same language model with three billion parameters. For 198 papers from the International Conference on Learning Representations, we compare model rankings of the original papers and of paragraph rewrites screened automatically for unchanged facts, claim strength, and attribution. The classifier ranks original papers closely with one predictor and moderately with the other, but shows no detectable agreement with either on which rewrites raise scores. The tests specified in advance used reduced numerical precision. Rounding error dominated the small score responses. We therefore rescored the released weights in full 32-bit precision as a post hoc check; edit agreement remained near zero. At this precision, when each predictor chooses among five rewrites per paper, its average raw score is under two points out of 100 higher than with random choice. The evidence covers presentation rewrites and two open predictors from one family; transfer to costly evaluators remains untested. Revision selectors should therefore be checked against the intended evaluator on the revisions they rank.
items.title_ko: 랭킹 일치가 두 개의 발표된 논문 승인 예측기에서 문단 편집 일치를 드러내지 않음
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 기존 논문에 대한 모델 랭킹 일치가 문단 편집 후의 랭킹 일치와 다르다는 것을 보여줍니다. 두 개의 발표된 논문 승인 예측기를 비교하여, 빠른 분류기가 느린 평가자를 위한 개정안을 선택하는 데 사용될 수 있는지 의문을 제기합니다.
items.why_ko: 논문 심사와 같은 복잡한 의사결정 과정에 AI를 적용할 때, 단순히 예측 정확도 외에 미묘한 텍스트 변화에 대한 민감도를 고려해야 함을 보여줍니다.

items.title: FedFiOT: Fisher-Weighted Optimal Transport for Model Merging in One-Shot and Few-Round Federated Learning
items.body: One-shot and few-round federated learning (FL) reduce communication burden by constructing a global model within one or a few communication rounds, but often achieve lower performance than conventional multi-round FL. Without frequent synchronization, client models may drift apart, causing neurons that learn similar features to occupy different positions across clients. At the same time, local data heterogeneity can cause corresponding parameters to differ in their importance to each client's predictions. Together, these challenges cause direct averaging to combine mismatched neurons and assign equal weight to parameters despite differences in their importance. We propose FedFiOT, a Fisher-weighted optimal transport framework for one-shot and few-round FL that leverages Fisher information to quantify parameter importance and guide neuron alignment and model aggregation. FedFiOT jointly optimizes neuron correspondences and global model parameters through alternating minimization of a shared Fisher-weighted objective. Theoretically, we show that FedFiOT's optimization procedure monotonically decreases the layer-wise merging objective and establish a stationarity bound that quantifies the effects of client heterogeneity and nonuniform Fisher weighting.Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over competing baselines in both one-shot and few-round federated learning settings.
items.title_ko: FedFiOT: 원샷 및 소수 라운드 연합 학습을 위한 피셔 가중치 최적 전송 기반 모델 병합
items.summary_ko: FedFiOT는 원샷 및 소수 라운드 연합 학습(FL)에서 통신 부담을 줄이면서 모델 성능을 향상시키기 위한 모델 병합 방법입니다. 이는 피셔 정보 가중치 최적 전송을 사용하여 클라이언트 모델 간의 뉴런 불일치와 로컬 데이터 이질성 문제를 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: 연합 학습의 효율성과 성능을 높이는 새로운 모델 병합 기술로, 분산된 환경에서 AI 모델을 훈련하고 통합하는 데 중요한 진보를 제공합니다.

items.title: Route First, See Later: Enabling Vision Agents to Reason Scientifically by Separating Routing Policy from Action Spaces
items.body:
Scientific image-analysis workflows require agents to select among diverse capabilities like description, detection, counting, and segmentation. Current multi-tool architectures conflate intent interpretation with visual execution, masking whether a failure arises from flawed reasoning (misrouting) or failed perception (invalid tool execution). This lack of auditability renders agents unreliable for high-stakes scientific automation. We introduce ZETA, an extensible architecture that operationalizes the decoupling of routing policy from action execution. ZETA resolves scientific intent before invoking specialized visual tools, treating measurement as a deterministic operation grounded in explicit geometry rather than generative output. This architecture exposes the "black box" of agent decision-making, allowing routing correctness and downstream execution to be evaluated as independent failure modes.
To our knowledge, we provide the first controlled study in scientific vision-agent routing that isolates explicit routing-policy specification while holding the legal action interface fixed. Evaluation on a zero-shot benchmark of 51 scientific-intent queries shows that explicit routing semantics can substantially improve routing accuracy, particularly at semantically adjacent action boundaries, although improvements vary across models. For Qwen 3.8, explicit routing-policy specification improves segmentation routing accuracy from 6.2% to 75.0% and detection routing accuracy from 60.0% to 100%. ZETA's execution traces make routing decisions and downstream artifacts separately observable, providing a basis for distinguishing intent-selection errors from visual execution failures. ZETA establishes the necessary infrastructure to isolate execution errors from interpretive ones, a critical requirement for deploying reliable scientific vision agents.
items.title_ko: 먼저 경로 지정, 나중에 시각화: 액션 공간에서 라우팅 정책을 분리하여 비전 에이전트의 과학적 추론 가능하게 하기
items.summary_ko: ZETA는 과학 이미지 분석 워크플로에서 비전 에이전트가 다양한 기능을 선택할 수 있도록 라우팅 정책을 액션 공간과 분리하는 확장 가능한 아키텍처입니다. 이는 실패 원인이 추론(잘못된 라우팅) 때문인지, 지각(유효하지 않은 도구 실행) 때문인지 명확히 하여 에이전트의 신뢰성을 높입니다.
items.why_ko: 과학적 추론과 같은 고위험 자동화 작업에서 AI 에이전트의 신뢰성과 감사 가능성을 크게 향상시킬 수 있는 근본적인 아키텍처 개선을 제시합니다.

items.title: Continual Classification Beyond the Kernel Regime: Harnessing the Sparsity Bias of L2 Regularization in Diagonal Linear Networks
items.body: We study logistic regression for continual learning with linear predictors in a high-dimensional statistical setting. Existing theoretical work has largely focused on continual linear regression with variants of L2 regularization, motivated by their analytical simplicity and connection to the kernel regime of neural networks. We first derive the optimal L2 regularization strength for continual linear classification and characterize its generalization performance, recovering behavior analogous to prior results for continual linear regression. Next, we examine the effect of L2 regularization in deeper models using a minimal two-layer diagonal linear network. In the single-task setting, L2 regularization on the weights of such models is known to promote sparsity in the resulting predictor, yielding a rich, sparse feature-learning regime beyond the kernel regime (a similar effect arises in two-layer ReLU networks). However, in continual learning, where L2 regularization is typically centered on previous-task weights, this sparsity bias is no longer preserved. We therefore propose a weighted variant of L2 regularization that extends this beneficial sparsity bias to continual learning. We show theoretically and empirically that, for a sufficiently sparse teacher, our variant converges substantially faster than directly learning a linear predictor with conventional continual L2 or L1 regularization, trading some long-horizon bias for markedly improved performance over moderate task horizons.
items.title_ko: 커널 영역을 넘어선 연속 분류: 대각선 선형 네트워크에서 L2 정규화의 희소성 편향 활용
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 고차원 통계 설정에서 선형 예측기를 이용한 연속 학습을 위한 로지스틱 회귀를 다룹니다. L2 정규화의 최적 강도를 도출하고 그 일반화 성능을 특성화하여, 커널 영역을 넘어선 연속 학습에 대한 통찰을 제공합니다.
items.why_ko: 연속 학습(continual learning) 분야에서 L2 정규화의 역할을 이해하고, 고차원 데이터에서 모델이 효율적으로 학습하고 일반화하는 방법을 개선하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: EvoWorld: Towards Out-of-Sight World Evolution in Generative Video Models
items.body: Generative video models are increasingly used as visual world simulators, yet their primary strength lies in rendering plausible pixels rather than reasoning about how a world should evolve. Coherent world evolution requires more than visual fidelity: when an event occurs, a model must infer its consequences for the entities in the world and then render the resulting state. For example, after a wild beast appears, the model should not only depict the wild beast, but also infer whether a nearby person should flee, take cover, or fight back based on the realized scene. Existing diffusion-based video models lack an explicit mechanism for maintaining world state and reasoning over such event-conditioned consequences, often producing visually plausible but behaviorally static or causally inconsistent outputs. To make this reasoning gap concrete and measurable, we propose a new problem, Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution, which requires a model to render an event, reason about its consequences for the evolving world state, and reveal a causally plausible outcome as the world continues to evolve, even out of sight. As a baseline reference solution, we introduce EvoWorld, a brain-renderer collaboration framework in which a vision-language model serves as the world brain: it observes generated segments, maintains an evolving account of the world, and reasons about plausible state transitions, while a segment-autoregressive video renderer realizes them visually. We further introduce EvoWorld-Data and EvoWorld-Bench for training and evaluating event realization, causal reactions, and revisit consistency. Experiments show that EvoWorld substantially improves event-conditioned causal evolution over recent models while preserving visual quality and consistency, establishing a reference point for reasoning-guided, autonomous world evolution beyond the current field of view.
items.title_ko: EvoWorld: 생성 비디오 모델의 '시야 밖' 세계 진화 연구
items.summary_ko: EvoWorld는 생성 비디오 모델이 단순히 그럴듯한 픽셀을 렌더링하는 것을 넘어, '시야 밖'에서 발생하는 사건의 결과를 추론하고 세계가 어떻게 진화해야 하는지 이해하는 능력을 연구합니다. 이는 시각적 충실도뿐만 아니라 세계의 일관된 진화를 요구합니다.
items.why_ko: 생성형 비디오 모델이 단순한 이미지 생성을 넘어 복잡한 세계의 인과관계를 이해하고 예측하는 능력을 개발하는 데 중요한 연구 방향을 제시합니다.

items.title: TailSteer: Trajectory-Tail Steering for Drift-Resistant Multi-turn Image Editing
items.body: Strong single-turn editing performance does not guarantee reliable multi-turn interaction: as edited outputs are repeatedly reused, small unintended changes can accumulate into severe visual drift. This long-term drift is often mitigated through training on multi-turn data or cross-turn rollouts, potentially altering pretrained priors, or through specialized inference-time mechanisms that are difficult to scale to foundation models. We introduce TailSteer, a final-stage training framework that improves multi-turn robustness while retaining the generative and editing capabilities acquired through earlier training. TailSteer follows a simple principle: keep early denoising dynamics close to those of the base model and concentrate preservation corrections near the trajectory tail, where fine-grained deviations can be suppressed. These corrections are learned from the editor's own on-policy denoising rollouts, using unchanged source content as a preservation reference without requiring curated ground-truth editing pairs. Experiments across the FLUX, SenseNova, and Qwen families show that TailSteer substantially reduces cumulative drift over 15-20 editing turns while largely preserving base-model performance on extensive text-to-image and single-image editing benchmarks. These results demonstrate that long-horizon editing robustness can be unlocked in foundation models after TailSteer, rather than by relearning their existing capabilities.
items.title_ko: TailSteer: 드리프트 방지 다중 턴 이미지 편집을 위한 Trajectory-Tail Steering
items.summary_ko: TailSteer는 다중 턴 이미지 편집에서 발생하는 시각적 드리프트(drift) 문제를 완화하기 위한 최종 단계 훈련 프레임워크입니다. 편집된 출력이 반복적으로 재사용될 때 발생하는 작은 의도치 않은 변화가 누적되어 심각한 시각적 드리프트를 야기하는 문제를 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: 생성형 AI를 이용한 다중 턴 이미지 편집의 일관성과 신뢰성을 크게 향상시켜, 복잡한 이미지 작업에서 AI의 실용적 활용도를 높일 수 있습니다.

items.title: Coupled Scene Graph Anticipation: When With-Constraint Recall Hides Structural Inconsistency
items.body:
Scene Graph Anticipation (SGA) predicts object relationships in future video frames. Continuous-time SGA models evolve each subject-object pair with an independent Neural ODE, so relationships sharing an entity cannot influence one another during integration, and nothing prevents mutually exclusive predictions, such as "sitting on" and "standing on", for the same pair. We introduce CoupledSGA, which links such relationships through a Relationship Interaction Graph with graph attention inside the ODE vector field, and adds a Structural Consistency Loss ($\mathcal{L}_{SC}$) based on a matrix of mutually exclusive predicates.
Developing CoupledSGA revealed a limitation of the evaluation protocol. With-Constraint evaluation keeps one predicate per group for each subject-object pair, so its R@K and mR@K cannot capture the within-group violations targeted by $\mathcal{L}_{SC}$: we prove they are unchanged whenever each group's winning predicate and its score are held fixed. We further show that the gradient of $\mathcal{L}_{SC}$ depends on predicate scores rather than ground-truth labels: for two-predicate rules it amplifies the ordering the model already holds, and when all scores in a group are equal it suppresses predicates in more exclusion rules more strongly, explaining why the penalty can lower recall while improving consistency.
On Action Genome, activating $\mathcal{L}_{SC}$ after two warm-up epochs reduces R@20 from 42.21% to 35.18% while lowering the No-Constraint contradiction rate from 45.92% to 4.07% (matched-budget R@20: 40.48% CoupledSGA vs. 44.78% SceneSayerODE). CoupledSGA is a testbed, not a state-of-the-art claim: With-Constraint recall captures the cost of enforcing structural consistency but not the improvement. We recommend reporting No-Constraint results alongside a contradiction rate for methods that constrain predicate co-activation.
items.title_ko: 결합된 장면 그래프 예측: 제약 조건부 리콜이 구조적 불일치를 숨길 때
items.summary_ko: CoupledSGA는 장면 그래프 예측(SGA)에서 개체 간의 관계가 독립적으로 진화하여 상호 배타적인 예측을 허용하는 문제를 해결합니다. 관계 상호작용 그래프(Relationship Interaction Graph)를 통해 관계를 연결하여 일관된 예측을 유도합니다.
items.why_ko: 비디오 프레임에서 객체 간의 미래 관계를 예측하는 AI 모델의 일관성과 정확성을 향상시키는 새로운 접근 방식을 제시하여, 비디오 이해 및 로봇 비전 분야에 기여합니다.

items.title: Smartphone-Aided VR Exergames for HIIT: Gamifying Fitness with Real-Time Pose Estimation
items.body:
This paper introduces an innovative virtual reality (VR) exergame system designed to gamify High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) workouts through 11 predefined combo moves, including squat-punch combinations, bilateral arm strikes, and diagonal stretch combos. Unlike conventional tracking methods that often rely on wearable motion capture suits or limited headset-based sensors, our system uses a standard smartphone camera placed on a tripod to capture full-body movement. This approach offers a cost-effective and scalable alternative, particularly well-suited to the fast, dynamic motions typical of HIIT routines.
The smartphone footage is processed in real time using a pose estimation algorithm, with extracted biomechanical data analyzed by a backend server built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Anthropic's open standard for connecting AI models to structured data sources and tools, and a GPT-4o large language model. The system generates personalized assessments of form accuracy, movement efficiency, exercise intensity, and potential injury risks, tailored specifically to high-impact, time-sensitive exercises.
A within-subject study involving 20 participants (ages 18-25) compared experiences in VR and Non-VR HIIT sessions. Results indicated significantly higher enjoyment (Mean = 3.5 vs 2.8, p = 0.02), improved immersion/focus (Mean = 3.2 vs 2.8, p = 0.03), and increased likelihood to recommend (Mean = 3.2 vs 2.7, p = 0.04) under the VR condition. Confidence to continue did not differ significantly between conditions (p = 0.15), while perceived intensity remained comparable. The MCP system showed strong agreement with expert evaluation (87.5%, N = 10 sessions, one certified trainer), supporting its reliability as a feedback tool.
items.title_ko: 스마트폰 지원 VR 엑서게임 HIIT: 실시간 자세 추정으로 피트니스 게임화
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 삼각대에 놓인 스마트폰 카메라를 사용하여 전신 움직임을 캡처하는 혁신적인 VR 엑서게임 시스템을 소개합니다. 이는 웨어러블 장치 없이도 고강도 인터벌 트레이닝(HIIT)을 게임화하고 실시간 자세 추정을 가능하게 합니다.
items.why_ko: 고가의 장비 없이 스마트폰만으로 VR 피트니스 게임을 즐길 수 있는 접근성 높은 솔루션을 제공하여, AI 기반 자세 추정 기술의 실생활 응용 가능성을 보여줍니다.

items.title: ConceptARC at Scale: Studying Conceptual Understanding in Reasoning Models
items.body: Large reasoning models (LRMs) perform well on challenging benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether they form generalizable abstractions across conceptually related reasoning tasks. The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) provides a controlled testbed for studying abstraction, requiring solvers to infer transformation rules over two-dimensional grids from a small set of examples. While ARC evaluates rule abstraction within individual tasks, different tasks may share higher-level structure despite requiring different transformations$\unicode{x2014}$for example, several tasks may involve reasoning about objects contained within other objects. Benchmarks such as ConceptARC capture this structure by grouping ARC-style tasks into recurring spatial and semantic concepts, but they often contain only a few manually constructed tasks per concept. We introduce ConceptARC at Scale, a generator for creating thousands of ARC-style tasks targeting a specific concept. Using this generator, we construct ConceptARC-100, a dataset of 1,600 new, manually reviewed tasks, with 100 tasks for each of the 16 concepts defined by ConceptARC$\unicode{x2014}$ten times the size of the original benchmark. We evaluate a range of recent LRMs and models trained from scratch on ConceptARC-100 to characterize which concepts they solve reliably and where they struggle. We further analyze the models' internal representations and find clear semantic structure: task representations cluster according to the operations applied to objects, such as recoloring, removal, or translation, even when realized through substantially different rules and scenarios. Together, our results suggest that models form stable abstractions of transformation operations that generalize across diverse tasks.
items.title_ko: ConceptARC 대규모: 추론 모델의 개념적 이해 연구
items.summary_ko: ConceptARC는 대규모 추론 모델(LRM)이 개념적으로 관련된 추론 태스크에서 일반화 가능한 추상화를 형성하는지 연구하는 벤치마크입니다. ARC(Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus)를 확장하여 다양한 태스크 간의 고수준 구조 이해 능력을 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델이 단순히 문제를 푸는 것을 넘어, 문제 뒤에 숨겨진 추상적인 개념을 이해하고 일반화하는 능력을 평가하는 데 중요한 기여를 합니다.

items.title: Template Gap Reconstruction for Shell Output Simulation with Small Language Models
items.body: Small language models offer a compact basis for shell simulation without executing submitted commands, but full-output decoding requires them to predict recurring utility structure alongside content that varies across executions. We introduce template gap reconstruction (TGR), which supplies reusable output literals interspersed with sentinels to be interleaved with autoregressively generated gaps. A template selector chooses which template to be reconstructed, with the empty template retaining full-output decoding. We construct a template bank from 18.7 million outputs collected across heterogeneous execution environments and train a template selector and five reconstruction models initialized from various small language model checkpoints on a target environment excluded from bank construction. Evaluation demonstrates that TGR improves output edit similarity (O-ES) over full-output decoding (FOD) when the optimal template covers more than 25\% of the template, while performing similarly for lower-coverage outputs. Additionally, TGR outperforms FOD for shorter gap sequences, with O-ES values of 0.964 and 0.812, respectively, while maintaining similar performance for longer sequences. TGR reduces the number of tokens generated by 26.3--38.3\% across used tokenizer families. These results support using a reusable output structure as a practical design choice for small shell simulators, improving response fidelity and shortening generation targets while keeping template selection and residual prediction central to response quality.
items.title_ko: 작은 언어 모델을 위한 셸 출력 시뮬레이션 템플릿 갭 재구성
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 작은 언어 모델(SLM)을 사용하여 셸 명령을 실행하지 않고 출력을 시뮬레이션하는 템플릿 갭 재구성(TGR) 방법을 소개합니다. TGR은 재사용 가능한 출력 리터럴과 자동 회귀적으로 생성된 갭을 결합하여 전체 출력을 디코딩합니다.
items.why_ko: 작은 언어 모델의 셸 출력 시뮬레이션 효율성을 높여, 제한된 컴퓨팅 자원에서 AI 기반 자동화 도구를 개발하는 데 유용합니다.

items.title: Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit
items.body: Streaming video understanding requires models to repeatedly decide whether to respond or continue observing. Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been applied to this setting, with existing approaches emphasizing reward design while retaining a single trajectory-level advantage across turns. Such shared credit can reinforce redundant replies after earlier successes and discourage useful follow-ups after earlier failures. We propose TurnWise, a turn-level GRPO framework that aligns learning with individual streaming decisions. TurnWise addresses the mismatch between trajectory-level feedback and turn-level interaction, promoting informative responses and reducing redundancy. Specifically, turn-level credit assignment uses silence-completed prefix scoring to construct group-relative advantages from each decision's remaining return, separating its learning signal from earlier rewards. Turn-mean policy optimization averages token losses within each turn and then across turns, giving response and waiting decisions equal weight regardless of output length. These complementary designs improve streaming policy learning without a learned critic or additional rollouts. Extensive experiments show our method outperforms prior RL approaches for streaming video understanding.
items.title_ko: 턴이 중요하다: 턴 레벨 크레딧을 통한 스트리밍 비디오 RL 발전
items.summary_ko: TurnWise는 스트리밍 비디오 이해를 위한 턴 레벨 GRPO(Group Relative Policy Optimization) 프레임워크로, 보상 설계를 넘어 턴 레벨에서 크레딧을 할당하여 정책 개선을 목표로 합니다. 이는 성공 후 불필요한 반복을 줄이고 실패 후 유용한 후속 조치를 장려합니다.
items.why_ko: 스트리밍 비디오 환경에서 강화 학습 에이전트의 의사 결정 능력을 향상시키는 새로운 접근 방식으로, 실시간 상호작용 시스템 개발에 기여합니다.

items.title: Dexterous Robotic Hands in the Foundation-Model Era: A Full-Stack Survey of Hardware, Data, Cross-Embodiment Transfer, Learning, and Evaluation
items.body: Dexterous robotic hands are increasingly coupled to large-scale human data and foundation models, yet progress in hardware, representation learning and evaluation is often assessed separately. This survey reviews work from January 2024 to early November 2026, with earlier studies included to establish technical lineages. We organize the literature into five interdependent layers: hardware; data collection and curation; cross-embodiment transfer; learning and foundation models; and evaluation and applications. Human hand-object understanding and tactile sensing provide two cross-cutting perspectives. A system-level architecture, comparative tables and five case analyses connect design choices across these layers. We distinguish within-study experimental comparisons from heterogeneous corpus statistics, vendor specifications and company-reported results. Three conclusions emerge. First, the value of human data depends on kinematic, visual and contact alignment, not recording volume alone. Second, shared action representations and foundation policies do not remove embodiment-specific constraints on force, latency and contact. Third, task completion is insufficient to establish physical correctness or deployment readiness. Evidence remains limited for zero-shot transfer of contact-rich skills between morphologically different hands, long-duration reliability, and cross-sensor tactile generalization. We identify eleven open problems and propose reporting interfaces and controlled comparisons that can make full-stack progress more measurable. The review is a structured narrative synthesis rather than a pooled performance ranking or an exhaustive systematic review.
items.title_ko: 파운데이션 모델 시대의 민첩한 로봇 손: 하드웨어, 데이터, 교차 구현 전송, 학습 및 평가에 대한 종합 설문조사
items.summary_ko: 이 설문조사는 2024년 1월부터 2026년 11월 초까지의 연구를 바탕으로, 파운데이션 모델 시대의 민첩한 로봇 손에 대한 하드웨어, 데이터 수집, 교차 구현 전송, 학습 및 평가 등 5가지 상호 의존적인 계층으로 문헌을 정리합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇 공학과 AI, 특히 파운데이션 모델의 융합 분야에 대한 최신 동향과 기술적 과제를 종합적으로 파악하는 데 도움을 주며, 미래 연구 방향을 제시합니다.

items.title: Symmetry Breaking at the Edge of Stability via Central Flow Analysis
items.body: Continuous symmetries in neural networks lead to conserved quantities that are invariant under gradient flow, such as layer balancedness in linear and ReLU networks. Finite-step gradient descent need not preserve these laws, particularly at the edge of stability (EOS), where the iterates oscillate around a smoother trajectory, which can be described by the central flow dynamics (Cohen et al., 2025). We study how gradient flow conservation laws evolve under the central flow description of this regime. We show that the curvature correction induces a finite-dimensional drift determined by the oscillation covariance along critical parameter directions. We thus take the first steps to analyse which conservation laws remain and are broken at the EOS according to the central flow dynamics by analysing a scalar two-layer model, two-layer matrix factorisation, and a two-layer ReLU network, where the known conservation laws are shown to be complete (Marcotte et al., 2023).
items.title_ko: 중심 흐름 분석을 통한 안정성 경계에서의 대칭성 파괴
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 신경망의 연속 대칭성이 경사 흐름 하에서 어떻게 보존되거나 파괴되는지 탐구합니다. 특히 안정성 경계(EOS)에서 반복이 더 부드러운 궤적 주위에서 진동할 때 중심 흐름 역학에 따라 대칭성 보존 법칙이 어떻게 진화하는지 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 신경망 훈련 과정에서 발생하는 대칭성 파괴 현상을 이해하고, 모델의 안정성과 수렴성을 개선하는 데 필요한 이론적 기반을 제공합니다.

items.title: Reasoning over Non-Parametric Memory in Multilingual LLMs: A Cognitive-Based Analysis of Relational Knowledge
items.body: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assumes that language models can reason over relations stated in their context rather than fall back on associations memorized during pretraining. We study this evidence-conditioned relational reasoning in isolation, with the facts supplied directly in the prompt rather than retrieved. \textsc{Rel-Bloom} is a controlled multilingual diagnostic of 450 multiple-choice questions built from 30 Wikidata relations; the same source relations are instantiated at five Bloom-inspired levels (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate) and under three veracity conditions (Factual, Counterfactual, Neutralized). Across 43 models, six languages, and two multilingual settings (226,800 predictions), three findings stand out. First, accuracy drops sharply from Apply to Analyze in every evaluated open-weight model series, reaching 47.2 percentage points for the Large Granite bucket, but not for either Gemini model. Second, Evaluate items remain a bottleneck even for models near ceiling on the other task types: Gemini~3.1 Pro averages 99.5\% on the other four levels but 60.7\% on Evaluate. Third, item- and relation-level difficulty rankings are consistently preserved across languages, indicating a difficulty structure partly shared across languages within this benchmark. Across knowledge conditions, Counterfactual contexts are generally harder than Factual ones, while removing entity identities can improve higher-level performance in some model regimes. Greater model capability therefore does not by itself ensure reliable reasoning over supplied relational evidence. Relevant resources are available at: https://huggingface.co/spaces/QCRI/non-parametric-memory-relational-reasoning.
items.title_ko: 다국어 LLM의 비모수적 메모리 추론: 관계 지식의 인지 기반 분석
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 RAG(검색 증강 생성)가 언어 모델이 사전 훈련 중 암기한 연관성에 의존하지 않고 컨텍스트에 명시된 관계를 추론할 수 있다고 가정하는 것을 탐구합니다. 'Rel-Bloom'이라는 다국어 진단 벤치마크를 사용하여 모델의 증거 조건부 관계 추론 능력을 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: 다국어 LLM이 컨텍스트 내의 정보를 기반으로 관계를 정확하게 추론하는 능력을 검증하고, 모델의 지식 활용 방식에 대한 통찰을 제공하여 RAG 시스템의 효율성 개선에 기여합니다.

items.title: Energy-Guided Transport for Projection-Free Physics-Informed Flow Matching
items.body: Deep generative models, particularly Flow Matching frameworks, have emerged as powerful tools for synthesizing complex physical systems. However, standard architectures remain purely statistically driven and agnostic to the underlying governing equations, often violating fundamental physical constraints during inference. Existing zero-shot approaches designed to enforce these constraints typically rely on rigid algebraic projections. While effective for sparse boundary conditions, applying such discrete geometric corrections to dense, full-domain PDEs may disrupt the probability path, \rev{potentially deviating from the learned manifold and introducing substantial computational overhead}. To address these challenges, we introduce Energy-Guided Transport, a novel training-free framework that formulates non-linear physical constraints as a smooth potential energy landscape. Rather than interrupting the ODE integration, our method applies a continuous dissipative force directly to the intermediate generative states, steering them toward the physical manifold. By evaluating this force implicitly via reverse-mode automatic differentiation, our framework preserves the natural dynamics of the flow while maintaining an efficient $\mathcal{O}(N)$ algorithmic complexity. We extensively evaluate our framework across various 1D and 2D physical systems, including the chaotic Navier-Stokes equations. Our method achieves stable generation without structural divergence, significantly improves the stability-accuracy trade-off compared to state-of-the-art methods, and substantially accelerates inference with respect to exact projection strategies. Code available at: https://github.com/ispamm/Projection-free-energy-guided-flow-matching.
items.title_ko: 에너지 유도 전송을 통한 투영 없는 물리 정보 유동 매칭
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 물리적 제약 조건을 위반하지 않고 복잡한 물리 시스템을 합성하기 위해 에너지 유도 전송(Energy-Guided Transport)을 통합한 투영 없는 물리 정보 유동 매칭(Projection-Free Physics-Informed Flow Matching) 프레임워크를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 물리적 제약 조건을 준수하는 생성 모델을 개발하여, 실제 물리 시스템 시뮬레이션 및 설계에서 AI의 신뢰성과 정확성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Beyond the principle-practice gap: Responsible AI as situated epistemic and ethical practice
items.body: Responsible AI scholarship has found that ethical principles are frequently not reflected in AI design and development. Conceptualised as a `gap' between principle and practice, this is framed as a problem of implementation, awareness or compliance, and by implication, a deficit of systems or individual behaviour. This paper sets out an alternative explanation. Drawing on fourteen semi-structured interviews with actors designing and governing AI-enabled anti-trafficking systems across law enforcement, commercial, research, and survivor-support contexts, it argues that such apparent gaps emerge from the varied and complex institutional and professional conditions through which actors come to recognise some issues, but not others, as ethical problems requiring action. We show that epistemic choices are intertwined with ethical judgements, and trace four interconnected moments---perception, judgement, situated action and socio-technical materialisation---through which concerns become intelligible, are weighed and acted upon, and are embedded in technical artefacts and governance arrangements. Actors often hold genuine ethical commitments, but these commitments are shaped by institutional logics and professional moral economies: some concerns are materialised, while others are narrowed, deferred or left unrealised. We show that ethical agency is exercised within and between competing constraints of profession, role, prior experience, and institutional settings. The paper argues that responsible AI governance requires purposeful and well-developed epistemic infrastructures that can cut across these constraints to establish institutional conditions through which the knowledge of affected communities and potential harms becomes receivable and actionable in design.
items.title_ko: 원칙-실천 간극을 넘어: 상황에 따른 인식적 및 윤리적 실천으로서의 책임감 있는 AI
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 책임감 있는 AI(RAI) 원칙이 AI 설계 및 개발에 반영되지 않는 문제를 '원칙-실천 간극'이라는 기존 관점 대신, RAI를 상황에 따른 인식적 및 윤리적 실천으로 재개념화하여 설명합니다. AI 기반 인신매매 방지 시스템을 설계하고 관리하는 사람들과의 인터뷰를 기반으로 합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 윤리 원칙이 실제 개발 과정에서 어떻게 적용되고, 어떤 문제에 직면하는지에 대한 심층적인 분석을 제공하여, 보다 실용적이고 효과적인 책임감 있는 AI 프레임워크 구축에 기여합니다.

items.title: ALTO: African and Levantine Tech-Facilitated Gender-Based Violence Corpus
items.body: Tech-facilitated gender based violence (TFGBV) is a pervasive online harm affecting women and gender minority groups through its many direct and covert forms. Current models and annotated datasets for gendered harm detection are dominated by data from, and models trained in, Global North languages. In collaboration with civil society organizations (CSOs) from Jordan, Francophone West Africa, and Kenya, we developed a community-led approach to crowdsource culturally and linguistically relevant instances of TFGBV in Levantine Arabic, African French, and Swahili. We annotated the crowdsourced data using active learning to develop a small but performant dataset (N=3022) called ALTO to improve TFGBV detection in the three languages. Through benchmarking and fine-tuning experiments, we show that existing harmful content detection models show poor TFGBV recall within ALTO and improve with fine-tuning. We found that models often miss covert harms across all languages, while error rates are markedly higher in Swahili. We report the experimental results and release the annotation taxonomy, dataset, and trained models.
items.title_ko: ALTO: 아프리카 및 레반트 기술 지원 젠더 기반 폭력 코퍼스
items.summary_ko: ALTO는 요르단, 프랑스어권 서아프리카, 케냐의 시민 사회 단체와 협력하여 기술 지원 젠더 기반 폭력(TFGBV)을 감지하기 위한 문화적, 언어적으로 관련성 있는 주석 데이터를 크라우드소싱한 코퍼스입니다. 기존 데이터셋이 글로벌 북부 언어에 치중되어 있는 문제를 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: 젠더 기반 폭력과 같은 온라인 유해 콘텐츠 감지 모델의 지역적, 문화적 편향을 해결하고, 다양한 언어 및 문화권에서 AI의 공정성과 포괄성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Where It Breaks: Diagnosing Perception, Memory, and Decision Failures of a Vision-Language Agent in Pac-Man
items.body: Training an agent to play Pac-Man with only up, down, left and right actions raises a basic question: when performance is poor, what should be improved? Difficulty can arise from reading the screen or from choosing actions over a long sequence. We examine these problems in a Qwen3.5-9B-based agent through separate perception checks and primitive-policy reinforcement-learning studies. In the policy study, which uses textual boards to remove image transcription from the decision interface, completion on eight held-out mazes increased from 0% before this optimization to 80.2% at a selected checkpoint, with three extra lives. The perception checks show that accurate static screenshot reading can coexist with errors during interaction. A separate policy comparison also shows that further optimization can accompany worse action choices. Together, these findings motivate concrete checks for post-training: evaluate perception in use, distinguish training success from full-game validation, and examine decisions and later performance rather than relying on one selected score. The study provides empirical lessons for improving future agent training and evaluation.
items.title_ko: 어디서 고장 나는가: 팩맨에서 비전-언어 에이전트의 인지, 기억, 의사결정 실패 진단
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 팩맨 게임을 플레이하는 Qwen3.5-9B 기반 비전-언어 에이전트의 성능 저하 원인을 인지, 기억, 의사결정 실패로 나누어 진단합니다. 별도의 지각 확인 및 원시 정책 강화 학습 연구를 통해 이러한 문제를 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 복잡한 게임 환경에서 AI 에이전트의 실패 원인을 체계적으로 진단하는 방법을 제시하여, 비전-언어 모델의 신뢰성과 견고성을 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: PINR-ESI: Physics-Informed Self-Supervised Implicit Neural Representation Framework for EEG Extended-Source Imaging
items.body: EEG extended-source imaging aims to localize active cortical regions and characterize their spatial extent, yet supervised inverse networks typically depend on synthetic EEG-source pairs and may be sensitive to synthetic-to-real mismatch. We propose a physics-informed self-supervised implicit neural representation (INR) framework for spatial source reconstruction without paired source labels or simulation-based supervised pretraining. The lead field matrix encodes the source-to-sensor volume-conduction model and constrains the INR through agreement between predicted and measured EEG. Cortical current density is modeled as a continuous coordinate-conditioned field. A classical inverse estimate provides warm initialization and spatial constraints on source activity, while patch-integrated projection maps the field to discrete source coefficients for forward modeling. Simulations with varying noise levels, source counts, and source extents showed the clearest advantage in identifying active cortical regions, particularly for multiple and larger sources. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations using real EEG recordings from epilepsy patients and intracranial stimulation experiments further supported the feasibility of the framework for source imaging. These findings suggest the potential of physics-informed self-supervised INR for extended-source imaging.
items.title_ko: PINR-ESI: EEG 확장 소스 이미징을 위한 물리 정보 자체 지도 암시적 신경망 표현 프레임워크
items.summary_ko: PINR-ESI는 페어링된 소스 레이블이나 시뮬레이션 기반 사전 훈련 없이 공간 소스 재구성을 위한 물리 정보 자체 지도 암시적 신경망 표현(INR) 프레임워크를 제안합니다. 이는 뇌파(EEG) 확장 소스 이미징의 기존 한계를 극복합니다.
items.why_ko: EEG 이미징 분야에서 훈련 데이터의 제약 없이 높은 정확도로 뇌 활동 소스를 재구성할 수 있는 새로운 방법을 제시하여, 뇌 과학 연구 및 임상 진단 발전에 기여합니다.

items.title: Don't Replace, Complement: A Detector-Agnostic Subspace Signal for Near-OOD Detection
items.body: Post-hoc out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is mature on far-OOD yet remains weak on near-OOD. These two settings differ in their use of class-characteristic feature directions: far-OOD inputs largely fail to activate those of their predicted class, whereas near-OOD inputs activate them much as in-distribution samples do. Because the axis separating far-OOD leaves near-OOD almost indistinguishable from ID, a score optimized for one setting is misaligned with the other; where a detector already saturates far-OOD, added near-OOD sensitivity is bought partly against it. This divergence motivates a targeted near-OOD signal designed to complement existing scores. We propose PLUS (Per-class Low-dimensional sUbspace Signal). For each class, PLUS selects the $m$ most class-active neurons from a sparse autoencoder, orthonormalizes the corresponding decoder directions to form a low-dimensional subspace, and scores an input by its per-class whitened squared Mahalanobis distance $z$ within the subspace of its predicted class. Designed as a dedicated complement rather than a standalone detector, the signal $z$ is fused additively with any calibrated base score at a single, fixed weight. This weight is a single global constant: no value is adjusted per backbone, per OOD dataset, or per deployment, and all calibration statistics are estimated from ID validation data alone. When applied to 18 existing detectors spanning diverse method families, $z$ consistently improves near-OOD AUROC in all 126 detector--backbone combinations. Far-OOD performance is broadly maintained or improved, with only marginal declines where the base score is near-optimal, making $z$ a robust, detector-agnostic complement across backbones.
items.title_ko: 교체 대신 보완: 근접 OOD 탐지를 위한 탐지기 불가지론적 부분공간 신호
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 근접 OOD(Out-of-Distribution) 탐지에서 기존 방법의 한계를 해결하기 위해 탐지기 불가지론적 부분공간 신호(Detector-Agnostic Subspace Signal)를 제안합니다. 이는 멀리 떨어진 OOD와 근접 OOD를 분리하는 데 사용되는 특징이 다르다는 점에 착안합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 신뢰성을 높이는 데 필수적인 OOD 탐지 기술을 개선하여, 실제 환경에서 예측 불가능한 입력에 대한 모델의 견고성을 강화합니다.

items.title: LifeVal: Evaluating AI Model Performance on Personalized Agentic Consumer Tasks
items.body: We introduce LifeVal, a benchmark evaluating AI model performance on personalized agentic consumer tasks. LifeVal covers the most valuable life tasks that a personalized digital superassistant could automate, representing over 1.7 trillion US dollars in annual willingness-to-pay across 148 consumer task categories (e.g., managing finances, moving apartments, searching for a job, finding childcare). To construct our activity distribution, we conducted a new survey of willingness-to-pay for a digital superassistant across a demographically representative sample of over 3,800 consumers, cross-referencing our results against the American Time Use Survey (Bureau of Labor Statistics, 2025) and the Multinational Time Use Study (Fisher et al., 2025). For the most valuable consumer activities, we recruited task creators to create AI evaluation tasks personalized using real ChatGPT conversations and memories, reference files, and personal context. Task creators had to pass our expertise threshold (including personally completing the task multiple times and seeing the results through in their real lives for over a year) and also write a rubric, ensuring that our evaluation measured the best personalized completion for that task. All tasks had to pass at least three rounds of human quality-control before acceptance into our final evaluation sets.
items.title_ko: LifeVal: 개인화된 에이전트 기반 소비자 태스크에서 AI 모델 성능 평가
items.summary_ko: LifeVal은 개인화된 에이전트 기반 소비자 태스크에서 AI 모델 성능을 평가하는 벤치마크입니다. 이는 금융 관리, 이사, 구직 등 148개 소비자 태스크 카테고리를 포괄하며, 개인화된 디지털 슈퍼 어시스턴트가 자동화할 수 있는 가장 가치 있는 삶의 태스크를 다룹니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트가 실제 사용자 삶에 얼마나 유용하고 가치 있는 서비스를 제공할 수 있는지 평가하는 새로운 표준을 제시하며, 개인화된 AI 어시스턴트 개발의 방향성을 제시합니다.

items.title: SecureGARD: Dynamic Ontology-Guided Governance for Secure Tool-Using LLM Agents
items.body: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents translate model outputs into consequential actions, turning indirect prompt injection into an execution-security problem. Existing defenses constrain tool calls, trajectories, or information flows, but often leave action semantics, state dependencies, and evidence relations implicit, limiting generalization across heterogeneous tools and complicating safe updates. We present \ours{}, a dynamic ontology-guided governance framework. \ours{} grounds heterogeneous calls in a shared semantic representation and combines an executable ontology with episode-level task state to derive deterministic ready, waiting, and forbidden decisions. A waiting decision identifies an unmet but recoverable obligation, enabling bounded replanning without expanding the agent's authorization boundary. \ours{} evolves its ontology offline from verified training executions. An offline LLM proposes instance-independent action--state axioms, which are accepted only if they address ontology errors exposed by training failures, preserve logical consistency and protected entailments, and pass held-out validation before the ontology is frozen. We evaluate \ours{} on AgentDojo, ASB, and AgentDyn under benign and indirect prompt-injection settings. \ours{} achieves a 0\% attack success rate (ASR) across all three benchmarks while improving task utility under attack compared with existing baselines. These results show that explicit semantic governance can strengthen execution security without indiscriminate blocking.
items.title_ko: SecureGARD: 안전한 도구 사용 LLM 에이전트를 위한 동적 온톨로지 기반 거버넌스
items.summary_ko: SecureGARD는 도구 사용 LLM 에이전트의 실행 보안 문제를 해결하기 위한 동적 온톨로지 기반 거버넌스 프레임워크입니다. 이는 도구 호출, 트레이스, 정보 흐름을 제약하는 기존 방어의 한계를 극복하고, 행동 의미론, 상태 종속성, 증거 관계를 명시적으로 파악합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 에이전트의 보안 및 신뢰성을 향상시키는 중요한 연구로, 다양한 도구를 사용하는 에이전트 시스템에서 안전한 운영을 보장하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Do unlearning algorithms learn the right features?
items.body: Machine unlearning is commonly evaluated with standard post-deletion metrics that compare an unlearned model to one retrained on the remaining data. Such snapshot evaluations can conceal consequential differences in the features the two models encode.
